sources.title: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next open weights, preview of Qwen4 architecture (2026-08-26)
sources.role: Discovery-bounded source used for factual verification

claims.text: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next shipped open weights on 2026-08-26 (HF + ModelScope, qwen-community-1.0): 125B MoE / ~6B active + 51B n-gram table, 262K context, multimodal; card frames it as a preview of the Qwen4 architecture (model_type=qwen4_exp).
claims.context: Card facts as relayed by technical secondary; HF card is verification target.

claims.text: vLLM PR #53909 (qwen4 fuse op) and SGLang PR #36585 (Qwen4Exp native support, agent-authored, failing CI) corroborate serving-side preparation for the qwen4_exp line.
claims.context: Secondary author's PR reading; PRs open/unmerged, direction signal only.

claims.text: Card benchmarks (DeepSWE 1.1 58.7, SWE-bench Pro 62.5, LiveCodeBench v6 91.9) and SGLang day-0 serving claims (540 tok/s) are unaudited.
Qwen 4 proper is unreleased (no date/card/weights); the September roadmap window is rumor.
